name: SPIN-Bench
description: SPIN-Bench is a multi-domain evaluation benchmark designed to measure LLMs' abilities in strategic planning and social reasoning across diverse social interaction scenarios including classical planning tasks, competitive and cooperative games, and multi-agent negotiation.
reputation: A recent benchmark for strategic planning and social reasoning that is not yet widely established as a standard leaderboard.
notes: Combines PDDL tasks, board games, card games, and negotiation scenarios; evaluates multi-agent reasoning and strategic behavior under uncertainty.
